notes.model: the original's file name, which Models: Detailed draws as our AIM-9 (shared/util/gltf.gd STORES: shared/extra/models/stores/aim9.glb); the sim has no install, so nothing else draws it
notes.number: ours; modern_weapons.gd finds its base by the name
notes.name: the base of the AIM-9X (modern_weapons.gd RECORDS)
notes.power: one hit destroys a fighter of strength 300 (our damage scale)
notes.blast_m: the AIM-9A / B's effective kill radius, about 9 m (the AIM-9M's is not published)
notes.drag: carriage drag index (10^4 x the drag coefficient on the F-16's 300 sq ft wing, flight-model.md §9.18): 0.4 x its 0.127 m across (w-aim9) frontal area, 0.4 the drag of a finned missile on its launcher rail on that area (inferred); the F-16 manual's published indices were not at hand
notes.motion._absAcceleration: Mach 0.7 to Mach 2.5 in about 5 s of motor burn (the burn time is open)
notes.motion._spiralAccelBeta: top speed a / beta = Mach 2.5 (851 m/s): 120 / 851
notes.motion._timeAcceleration: the burn with which the missile flies 17.7 km from 250 m/s before its flight ends 6 s after the burn (real_weapons.gd's rule)
notes.motion._timeConstOrientation: flies straight 0.5 s off the rail

footnotes.ds-aim9: designation-systems.net, "Raytheon AIM-9 Sidewinder" (AIM-9L / M 86 kg, Mach 2.5+; AIM-9A / B effective kill radius about 9 m), https://www.designation-systems.net/dusrm/m-9.html
